cards.info: How do you convert a decimal to a percentage?
cards.backInfo: Move the decimal point exactly two places to the right and add a percent sign (%).

cards.info: What is the first step to convert a fraction to a decimal?
cards.backInfo: Divide the numerator (top number) by the denominator (bottom number).
cards.imageMarkdown: ![A flow chart showing the steps: Fraction, Divide, Decimal, Shift Right 2 Places, Percent.](https://img.justsolvely.com/followUpImage/92d86336-0dcb-4454-a822-598fd2ace358-1786505449195-462.webp)

cards.info: What percentage corresponds to a decimal value greater than 1?
cards.backInfo: A decimal value greater than 1 corresponds to a percentage greater than 100%.

cards.info: What percentage corresponds to a decimal value less than 0.01?
cards.backInfo: A decimal value less than 0.01 corresponds to a percentage less than 1%.

cards.info: How do you convert a percentage back to a decimal?
cards.backInfo: Move the decimal point two places to the left and remove the percent sign.

cards.info: What happens if you shift the decimal only one place when converting?
cards.backInfo: The resulting percentage value will be ten times too small.

cards.info: What is 0.8 expressed as a percentage?
cards.backInfo: 80%. A placeholder zero is used to shift the decimal two places.

cards.info: What does the term 'percent' literally mean?
cards.backInfo: It means 'per one hundred', which is why you divide by 100 to get a decimal.

cards.info: How do you convert a percentage to a fraction?
cards.backInfo: Place the numerical value over 100 and simplify the resulting fraction.

cards.info: What are the decimal and percentage equivalents of 1/4?
cards.backInfo: The fraction 1/4 is equivalent to 0.25 and 25%.

cards.info: Convert 0.004 to a percentage using the Shift-and-Label strategy.
cards.backInfo: 0.4%. Move the decimal two places right (0.004 to 0.04) and add %.

cards.info: What is the decimal equivalent of 5/8?
cards.backInfo: 0.625. This is found by dividing the numerator 5 by the denominator 8.
cards.imageMarkdown: ![A flow chart showing the steps: Fraction, Divide, Decimal, Shift Right 2 Places, Percent.](https://img.justsolvely.com/followUpImage/92d86336-0dcb-4454-a822-598fd2ace358-1786505449195-462.webp)

cards.info: If a value is 1.25, will its percentage be above or below 100%?
cards.backInfo: Above 100%. Any decimal value greater than 1 corresponds to a percentage over 100%.

cards.info: Is the percentage equivalent of 0.007 greater or less than 1%?
cards.backInfo: Less than 1%. Decimals smaller than 0.01 result in percentages less than 1%.

cards.info: Convert 7% to a decimal.
cards.backInfo: 0.07. Move the decimal point two places to the left and remove the % sign.

cards.info: Why is converting 0.5 to 5% considered a common mistake?
cards.backInfo: The decimal was only moved one place; it must move two places to 50%.

cards.info: How can you mathematically verify that 0.45 is 45%?
cards.backInfo: Multiply the decimal by 100 ($0.45 \times 100 = 45$) to confirm the percentage.

cards.info: When converting 0.2 to a percentage, what must be added to shift correctly?
cards.backInfo: A placeholder zero must be added, resulting in 20% instead of 2%.

cards.info: How does the definition of 'percent' explain the conversion of 25% to 0.25?
cards.backInfo: 'Percent' means 'per 100', so 25% is $25 \div 100$, which equals 0.25.

cards.info: Express 25% as a simplified fraction.
cards.backInfo: 1/4. Place 25 over 100 ($25/100$) and simplify by dividing both by 25.
